tools.name: search_living_memory
tools.description: Use when the user asks to search Kweku Anansi or wants African historical, cultural, geographic or ecological context about named places, peoples, figures or events. Searches an editorial collection. Does not provide live jobs, clinical advice, current regulations or unrestricted web search.

tools.name: get_memory_entry
tools.description: Read an exact public editorial entry using an id returned by search_living_memory. Do not invent entry IDs.

tools.name: get_collection_coverage
tools.description: Check the size, categories and source version of the public Kweku Anansi collection. Does not imply clinical validation, current events coverage or live translation support.

tools.name: search_herbarium
tools.description: Find botanical name records by scientific name, vernacular name or family in the Kweku Anansi Herbarium. Returns source-record identity and toxicity-flag status, never a safety clearance. Not for specimen identification, symptoms, treatment, dosing, preparation or clinical advice.

tools.name: get_plant_record
tools.description: Read an exact Herbarium botanical identity record from a slug returned by search_herbarium. Common names are ambiguous. Not a specimen identification or medical advice service.

tools.name: compare_plant_records
tools.description: Compare two to four distinct botanical records using slugs returned by search_herbarium. Shows names, families, source toxicity flags and missing records side by side. Does not compare clinical efficacy or recommend plant substitution, ingestion or treatment.

tools.name: search_compound_records
tools.description: Search public Duke CC0 compound associations projected from Kweku Anansi Herbarium source cards by compound name or InChIKey. For botanical/phytochemical reference research only. These are not new lab results, target predictions, clinical evidence or evidence of concentration, safety, dose or therap

tools.name: lookup_language_term
tools.description: Look up an exact Ga or Twi word or English meaning in source-checked lexical records. This does not verify pronunciation, translate arbitrary sentences or provide audio. Retain source rights and context.

tools.name: get_language_entry
tools.description: Read an exact lexical record ID returned by lookup_language_term. No guessed IDs, private recordings or bulk downloads.

tools.name: search_reviewed_opportunities
tools.description: Search fresh reviewed public opportunities by explicit ISO country and topic. Distinguish sector signals, verified openings and published application routes; a route with unknown deadline is not an open cohort. No country inference from phone, personal profiling or eligibility decisions.

tools.name: get_reviewed_opportunity
tools.description: Read a returned opportunity ID only while its review is fresh and application deadline has not expired. Pass the explicit country when known; mismatches return not found. Stale, closed and withdrawn entries are withheld.
